opMode.description: OpMode name as shown in the Runtime panel (the @TeleOp/@Autonomous name)

robotPreset.description: chassis preset; omit to keep the browser's saved robot Overrides twinSettings.

hardwarePreset.description: hardware-map names preset; omit to keep the saved map

assetOverrides.description: asset path -> dotted key -> value, merged into the JSON assets at INIT

start.description: our start pose; omit for the configured start position

set.description: gamepad fields: lx ly rx ry lt rt (numbers), a b x y lb rb back start guide du dd dl dr ls rs (booleans)

telemetryIncludes.description: regexes that must match some telemetry line at some sample Checked against the 1 Hz samples and the 10 Hz telemetry change log.

telemetrySequence.description: Regexes that must first appear in this order during the run (checked against the 10 Hz telemetry change log, so states lasting under a second count).

scoreAtLeast.description: Our alliance's match score at the end must be at least this (Table 10-2 scoring).

ignoreBindings.description: do not apply TeamCode/twin-bindings.json for this run (assets as committed)

twinSettings.description: Run the robot the human runs: true loads TeamCode/twin-settings.json from the team repo (the file the twin's Session section saves), or give a path relative to --team. Its robot, intake side, cameras, launcher, hardware map, calibration and asset overrides are applied first; the scenario's alliance, opponents, starts and assetOverrides override, and robotPreset/hardwarePreset (if given) replace the file's robot.
